$provenance.target: Two local HQ processes on one disposable PostgreSQL database with fake Zerops and a fake Mate
steps: In a clean checkout of writerCommit, install conformance dependencies; put PostgreSQL 17 and Git 2.44 or newer on PATH and set GOTOOLCHAIN=local.

In a standalone Node development check use conformance/scripts/test-hq-build.ts prepareTestBinaries to build HQ, the box and the test operators; startHq with the s8-helpers and s12a-helpers environments and its migrated template, then startPeer on the same database. Zerops, object storage and Mate are local fakes.
Using s5-helpers.ts, setup the owner and first Mate project, enroll it, and placeMate for the second project. Open the first Mate link and wait for firstState.

Send the full overviewOf with claude-code signedInBy and lastSignedInBy owner, present true and token false. Subscribe to navigation on the first HQ and wait until project:<first project ID> reports signedInNow claude-code owner.

Subscribe to navigation on the peer and take the first delivery's value for project:<first project ID>. Save it normalized with stable from conformance/harness/recordings.ts. Close both navigation sockets and the Mate link, stop the peer and HQ, and release the disposable local PostgreSQL and fake services.

In standalone Node, set HQ_RECORD_EXEMPLARS to an output directory, set expect.getState().testPath to conformance/rolling-restart.test.ts using expect.setState, and call recordExemplar from conformance/harness/recordings.ts with the saved peer value and this target and steps. Compare its value to this recording. The standalone check did not run the conformance case or suite.
